name: Not Diamond
summary: Not Diamond is a model router that predicts which model to use for each input, aiming to lower cost while keeping accuracy. It now focuses on coding agents and plugs into existing harnesses and gateways through an API rather than replacing them. It decides the model; the request still goes through your provider or gateway.
goodFor: Cutting coding-agent spend across several models
Adding routing on top of an existing gateway
Teams with many engineers on agents
watchOut: Adds a routing decision service to the request path
